assessments.reasoning: I checked the publisher's verified v3.13.0 tag against its exact commit, independently fetched the exact official file over HTTPS, and verified its byte digest. I read the frozen cited passage (PEP 594 removal, lines 1484–1507). The release note includes cgi in the explicitly removed set and dates that set's deprecation to Python 3.11. PEP 594's schedule and module row agree for cgi. No cgi.py or import spec was found in the reviewed local environment. The pinned release note establishes the 3.13 edition removal and 3.11 deprecation history, independently of locally installed third-party modules.

challenge.method: Distinguish an available third-party package of the same name from standard-library distribution. Compare PEP 594 and inspect the local 3.13.5 standard-library path for cgi.py and the isolated module spec.
challenge.results: No cgi.py or import spec was found in the reviewed local environment. The pinned release note establishes the 3.13 edition removal and 3.11 deprecation history, independently of locally installed third-party modules.

limitations: Runtime absence was observed on one isolated local CPython 3.13.5. Removal from the standard library does not rule out external distributions.
